title: 第19章 御兽卡的辛秘
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“喵呜~”

    第二天一早，林奇还在睡梦中，就感觉脸颊传来一阵刺痛。

    他迷迷糊糊地睁开眼，映入眼帘的是风铃猫毛茸茸的脑袋，它正蹲在自己胸口，舔着爪子，显然刚才的刺痛就是它搞的鬼。

    “风铃猫，都说了你舌头有倒刺，舔人很疼的！”

    林奇伸手推开风铃猫的脑袋，可这小家伙半点不怵，反而顺势往他怀里钻，几十斤的重量让他一口气没喘过来，差点噶了。

    “咳咳，不是都说养猫人是快乐的吗？为何我的快乐消失了。”

    林奇无奈地坐起身，看着赖在自己腿上不肯走的风铃猫，只能运转体内的源力喂给它。

    御兽卡有一个好处，那就是如果主人实在养不起卡兽，还可以输送源力蕴养卡牌，这样卡兽吸收了能量也可以吃饱。

    直到源力耗空，风铃猫才从卡牌中跳了出来，伸了个懒腰，尾巴高高翘起，显然已经吃饱喝足，精神得很。

    “刚恢复的源力，就这样被你吃光了。”

    林奇在床上盘腿而坐，趁着源力耗空开始修炼源力。

    昨天辛苦了一晚上，他已经将百张尘星卡铁剑融合成了二十张一星卡佣兵佩剑。

    还有十张一星卡小火球也被融合成了两张魔法卡爆裂火球。

    只不过这两张魔法卡他不打算卖，想着先给林峰和瑞廉更换下副卡。

    这两个人的副卡简直是惨不忍睹，只有林峰好一些，有一张绿色技能卡，但其余的也只能用白到发光来形容。

    这就是御卡师，只要踏上这条路，那这辈子就只能在拼命赚钱的路上。

    也得益于这段时间融卡总是耗尽源力，每天都要修炼恢复几十次，身为一星卡徒的林奇，源力储备甚至比二星卡徒还多。

    但卡徒就是卡徒，源力恢复得快，消耗的更快。

    ......

    “踏踏踏。”

    林奇慵懒的走下楼，风铃猫在他屁股后面摇着尾巴跟着。

    林峰也从厨房端着早饭走了出来。

    “儿子，你瑞廉叔已经去佣兵团宣传去了，估计今天就会有人来咱家买卡牌。你那准备的怎么样了？”

    林奇走到餐桌旁，从口袋里掏出一沓卡牌。
content_en:
"Meow~"

Early the next morning, while Lynch was still asleep, he felt a stinging pain on his cheek.

He opened his eyes drowsily, and what he saw was the furry head of the wind chime cat. It was squatting on his chest, licking its paws. It was obvious that the stinging pain just now was caused by it.

"Wind Chime Cat, I've been told that your tongue has barbs and it will be very painful to lick someone!"

Lin Qi stretched out his hand to push the wind chime cat's head away, but the little guy was not frightened at all, and instead crawled into his arms. The weight of dozens of kilograms made him unable to breathe and almost collapsed.

"Ahem, don't they say cat owners are happy? Why has my happiness disappeared?"

Lin Qi sat up helplessly and looked at the wind chime cat that was leaning on his lap and refused to move. He could only use the source of power in his body to feed it.

One advantage of the beast control card is that if the owner really cannot afford to feed the card beast, he can also send the source power accumulation card, so that the card beast can eat enough after absorbing the energy.

It wasn't until the source of power was exhausted that the wind chime cat jumped out of the card, stretched out, and raised its tail high. It was obvious that it had eaten and drank enough and was very energetic.

"The newly recovered source power was eaten up by you like this."

Lin Qi sat cross-legged on the bed and began to practice his source power while it was exhausted.

After working hard all night yesterday, he had fused a hundred dust star card iron swords into twenty one star card mercenary swords.

There are also ten small fireballs of one-star cards that are also fused into two bursting fireballs of magic cards.

It's just that he doesn't plan to sell these two magic cards, and wants to replace the secondary cards for Lin Feng and Ruilian first.

The secondary cards of these two people are simply terrible. Only Lin Feng is better, with a green skill card, but the rest can only be described as white to glowing.

This is the card master. As long as you set foot on this path, you will only be able to make money desperately in this life.

Also thanks to the fact that Rong Ka always depleted his source power during this period, he had to practice and recover dozens of times every day. As a one-star card disciple, Lin Qi had even more source power reserves than a two-star card disciple.

But Katu is Katu, and his source power recovers quickly and is consumed even faster.

...

"Tap tap tap."

Lin Qi lazily walked downstairs, and the wind chime cat followed him, wagging its tail behind his butt.

Lin Feng also walked out of the kitchen carrying breakfast.

"Son, your Uncle Ruilian has already gone to promote the mercenary group. It is estimated that someone will come to our house to buy cards today. How are your preparations?"

Lynch walked to the dining table and took out a stack of cards from his pocket.
